meta.name: title
meta.content: Giza plateau: Khufu, Khafre, Menkaure, Sphinx proxy and interior

meta.name: description
meta.content: The Giza plateau as a declarative X3D 4.1 scene: Khufu as 203 stepped masonry courses (138.5 m present height, 230.33 m base, 51.84 deg), the restored Tura limestone casing (146.6 m), Khafre with its surviving cap casing, Menkaure with its red granite lower courses, a Sphinx proxy, and a schematic interior (passages, chambers, the 2017 Big Void and 2023 North Face Corridor). Procedural geometry and textures; positions from WGS84 coordinates; a simulacrum, not a survey.

meta.name: reference
meta.content: Petrie, The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh (1883); Morishima et al., Nature 552:386 (2017); Procureur et al., Nature Communications 14:1144 (2023)
